{"notes":"### RuForge 0.1.8

- **Playlist downloads**: paste or drop playlist URLs, per-video audio in preview, duplicate badges before enqueue, and one Media stack card per playlist folder.
- **SponsorBlock and scrubber**: all skip/chapter/POI categories fetch on play; color-coded hover labels on scrub segments; sprite reload after Generate Previews.
- **Settings updates**: yt-dlp Check & Update in Downloads; Advanced Check auto-downloads RuForge when a newer build exists.","additions":["Playlist downloader: URL intake from clipboard, paste, and drop; per-row audio toggle and sizes; duplicate summary before Download; batch jobs land in a numbered playlist subfolder with one Media stack card","Regroup flat playlist files into a numbered folder from Settings Debugging tab (library match by id, url, or title)","SponsorBlock fetches all skip, chapter, and POI categories (not sponsor-only API default); stale sidecars refresh on next play","Color-coded scrub hover pill for every SponsorBlock segment type (skip, chapter, POI, music off-topic, etc.)","Settings Downloads: yt-dlp Check & Update checks GitHub and installs a newer user copy automatically","Settings Advanced: Check for updates auto-downloads and installs RuForge when a newer build is available","General settings toggle reveals Debugging tab (group playlist tool and updater UI cycle)","Post-install What's New modal clamps to the viewport with a scrollable notes body"],"fixes":["Simple (no-chapter) seek bar no longer clips scrub hover previews","Scrubber sprite sheets reload after Generate Previews; sidecar duration from ..info.json for sprite timing","Mini player large mode: video frame no longer washed by stacked blur or idle ambient blur","Playlist regroup scans internal and custom library roots and matches entries by id, url, or title"]}
